context: Either enumerate ruleset required contexts (from runbook pin / API) or accept an explicit multi-name list including Results Explorer browser gate. Prefer reading the same source as ruleset drift docs so contexts do not drift. Tests for multi-check green vs partial green.
description:
`_project/scripts/green_unmerged_sweep.py` uses REQUIRED_CHECK_NAME = "ci-required-result" (or equivalent) as "required lane green". Develop ruleset also requires "Results Explorer browser gate". A PR can be classified sweep-green while the browser gate is red; GitHub auto-merge still waits on all required checks so merge safety is intact, but the sweep's "green" label and any --apply logic are incomplete.

Identified in browser-gate adversarial review (C3) and overall batch residual audit 2026-08-05. Sibling of green-unmerged-sweep-intentional-hold-false-positives-20260805 (classifier semantics); this item is specifically multi-context required-check completeness.
